notes.title: Release_ver_2.06.15 Update (Hotfix) Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is HellAssociation, the developers of Who’s Next. 


We have released a hotfix version that addresses bugs found in the previous patch. 


Please take note of the changes when playing the game. 




Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where players other than the host could use the reset button in game settings.


Fixed a bug where exclusive clues from the “Who’s Number?” mode (e.g., “A is an odd/even number.”) appeared in other game modes. These clues are now restricted to the proper mode only.




Thank you for playing Who’s Next. 


Sincerely, HellAssociation.

notes.title: Release_ver_2.03.29 Update
notes.notes:
Release_ver_2.03.29

[Bug Fixes]


 Fixed an issue where the [Confusion] tool would occasionally not function properly.
 Fixed a bug where global ability tools (e.g., Confusion, Frontpage Feature) would sometimes not play their SFX.
 Fixed a bug where ending a routine immediately with the ESC key as soon as the “Complete” indicator appeared allowed early termination of the routine.
 Fixed a bug where Changgwi would sometimes spawn in an immobile position.
 Fixed an issue where location clues were not displaying correctly.
 Fixed a bug that caused movement to be disabled if time changed while the chat window was open.
 Fixed overlapping text between clues and objective descriptions in the Detective Notebook.
 Mitigated an issue where the game would not end properly.
 Fixed a bug where the reset button in the microphone/control settings did not work.
 Fixed an issue where some expression costumes showed colored outlines.
 Fixed an issue where some costumes rendered behind or overlapped incorrectly when equipped.
 Fixed a bug where some costumes appeared differently than in the wardrobe.
 Fixed a bug where, when only three players remained and SackMan died, the kidnapped player would also die.

 Fixed a bug in the "Archery" routine in Yeomla Palace that prevented it from progressing normally.

Tools

You can now switch to a different game background/mode from the waiting room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/ab35e8e87f2accb3318def5cfdea7a0bee28df26.gif

notes.title: Release_ver_2.03.18 Update
notes.notes:
Release_ver_2.03.18

[Bug Fixes]


 Fixed a bug where the hotkeys for emotes and the deduction notebook could not be modified.
 Fixed a bug where the initial starting position did not appear correctly.


[Adjustments]


 The shop UI can now be closed using the ESC key.
 If a private waiting room is in progress, it will now display an indicator showing that the game is ongoing.
 Waiting rooms in the lobby are now sorted in order of (Public → Private).
 The responsiveness of ‘Tombstone Cleaning’ at the entrance of the Chaos Underworld has been adjusted. (It has been made easier to clean.)
 The difficulty of ‘Drawing Talismans’ at the entrance of the Chaos Underworld has been adjusted. (It has been made easier to perform.)
 Some abilities now have more detailed tooltips. (GangChul, Preta)

 Clues
* The base power of standard clues has been slightly increased. To adjust the game tempo, the default setting for *Unlucky Day* has been changed to ON. (The default value has been adjusted so that players can collect approximately 2-3 meaningful clues per round.)
* Clues that were too difficult to interpret or were too ambiguous have been modified. (* A - Player name / B - Spirit name)

 A has never purchased a tool. → Removed.
 A has used their spirit ability N times. → Removed.

 A and B have the closest relationship. → A and B are either each other’s target or hunter. (Terminology change)
 B and A have the closest relationship. → A and B are either each other’s target or hunter. (Terminology change)

 The default setting for *Unlucky Day* (which allows meaningless clues to appear) has been changed from OFF to ON.
 The probability of meaningless clues appearing in *Unlucky Day* has been adjusted. - 30% → 20%

 GangChul
 GangChul is designed as a last-minute comeback character. However, due to various external debuffs, there have been frequent cases where GangChul could not defeat enemies even after transforming at a high cost. To ensure GangChul can eliminate at least 1-2 opponents after transformation, movement speed has been increased.

 The movement speed increase of GangChul’s ability [Ascension] has been adjusted.
 [Ascension] movement speed increase: 40% → 55%


[New Content]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/301352bce7d9df2eeb715d0797160b327eac507d.png
New Spirit - SackMan

SackMan, known for abducting disobedient children, is quite a notorious figure even in the living world. The reason for his relentless kidnappings remains unknown, but it is said that his sack contains all sorts of bizarre creatures and cruel tools.  
And what happens to the children trapped inside? …Let’s not imagine that.


 Type: Offensive / Utility
 This spirit can eliminate enemies regardless of target relationships, but the process takes time.  
 Abducted players can do nothing but scream for help. The only way to escape is using [Flame Heart], so use your strategy wisely.  
 Movement speed decreases significantly for each abducted player, so be cautious of your hunters before you process your captives.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/a7be8454fa051fe53c242b6b438dd788fab2494c.png

 Spirit Ability - I'm Coming for You~!
 Cooldown: 30 seconds


Instantly abducts the nearest opponent and traps them in SackMan’s sack.  
Movement speed decreases by 20% for each abducted opponent.  
If this state is maintained for 44 seconds, the trapped opponents are eliminated one by one.

* SackMan’s Perspective
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/ca44957adc9b72138953532ae81bedf9e6f6a5c2.gif

* Abducted Player’s Perspective
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/7a61995903d85ce6fc6eceb7c704371f06dc85c1.gif


 If SackMan is eliminated within 44 seconds, all abducted players are released.
 The visual effect and sound of [I'm Coming for You~!] can be seen and heard by all players.
 Abducted players become invisible but can still use voice chat.
 If all non-abducted players die, all abducted players will be automatically eliminated.
 The abducted state applies the [Bound] + [Stunned] debuffs and can only be removed with [Flame Heart].
 While abducted, players cannot dash, move, use tools, or activate abilities (including Twilight-type abilities).
 If an abducted player enters Twilight, they can still access the shop.
 The 44-second timer for the abducted state only progresses during day and night.
 Players who are still alive can continue to communicate with others during Twilight.
 Abducted players' voices will be distorted.
 Symbiotic Death - If you use the ability on an ally, there is no way to undo it except with [Flame Heart]... (Wishing you a successful negotiation within the 44 seconds...)

 If Gumiho is abducted while casting an ability, their ability [Charm] will be canceled.
 If Uchi is in [Possession] mode, they can still use their ability while abducted until they are eliminated. (They can continue to disrupt enemies.)

notes.title: RELEASE_ver_2.03.08 Update
notes.notes:
ver_2.03.08 Patch Notes

[Bug Fixes]


 - Fixed an issue where voice chat did not function properly when entering the lobby intermittently.
 - Fixed an issue where voice chat input was not working correctly upon entering the lobby intermittently.
 - Fixed a bug where the private setting in the game settings (*GameSetting*) in the lobby was not functioning properly.
 - Fixed a bug where local save data was corrupted for players who had previously played the *DEMO* version.
 - Fixed a bug where the winter theme was still displayed for players who had played the *DEMO* version.
 - Fixed an issue where *Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese* fonts were misaligned or not displayed properly.
 - Fixed a bug where *dash cooldown* was not applied in *Soul Trial Mode*.
 - Fixed a bug where it was possible to set a *blank nickname*.
 - Fixed an issue where if a player left the game mid-match, the target of that player was not reassigned correctly.
 - Fixed a bug where players would die due to *[Spiled Mike]* even when performing a legitimate attack.
 - Fixed an issue where the *tail chase order* was not recognized correctly when altered by *Headconfuser’s* ability.
 - Fixed a bug where hints in the altered *tail chase order* (*due to Headconfuser's ability*) would only appear based on the remaining players.
 - Fixed an issue where the *chat window during Twilight Time* and the *chat window in Observer Mode* were sometimes out of sync.
 - Fixed a bug where *Woochi’s ability "Clone Technique!"* occasionally did not function properly.
 - Fixed a bug where *Woochi’s ability "Blink Left! Blink Right!"* would occasionally make the player *invisible* after use.
 - Fixed an issue in *Hellfire Furnace Refining* where pressing *ESC* to exit the mission could sometimes prevent further progression.
 - Fixed a bug where the *SFX* for *[Scroll: Protection Spell]* was played *globally* regardless of distance.
 - Fixed an issue where if the player died while casting *[Scroll: Random Teleport]*, the character did not turn *invisible*.
 - Fixed a bug where the *coin consumption* of *GangChul’s ability [Ascend]* was not displayed correctly.
 - Fixed an issue where the *background* of the *in-game announcements UI* sometimes did not disappear.
 - Fixed a bug where *purchasing Grudge during Twilight Time while in Observer Mode* caused the transformed *Changgui* character to become *immobile*.
 - Fixed several issues that occurred when a player was *stunned while dashing*.
 - Fixed a bug where players who stepped on *[Small Trap]* and were *stunned* could not move for *more than 2 seconds intermittently*.


[Adjustments]


 - Updated the *Soul Story* images in the *guide panel* (*supports multiple languages*).
 - Adjusted some *UX elements* in the *GameSetting* options.
 - **[Advanced Hints]** will now always display information about *a player other than the purchaser*.
 - The total number of *coins required* to collect when playing as a *Preta Soul* is now displayed.
 - **Gumiho**
 - *Charm (Newbie Slayer)*
 - Adjusted the *casting time* for *Gumiho's ability [Charm]* from **2s → 2.5s**.


[New Features]


 - The *UI for ability usage guidance* now appears when clicking on the *Soul abilities* of **Doppelrat / Reaper**, as shown below.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/96908e6fae7396d3182cdc828fc562ce2c15db87.gif
 - Added the following *new costume items*:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/01bace342f7e215f74ca4dc322b500c4b1d391b0.png
 - **Hat**: *Frog* → **Scheduled for 03/09 update**
 - **Expression**: *Dizzy*
 - **Hand Decoration**: *Death Ledger*
 - **Hand Decoration**: *Dokkaebi Club*
 - **Hand Decoration**: *Talisman!*
 - **Hand Decoration**: *Cheerleader*
 - **Shroud**: *Suit*
 - **Entry Effect**: *Darkness*
 - **Entry Effect**: *Halo*
 - **Entry Effect**: *Gumiho*
 - **Special**: *Clown*

notes.title: Release_ver_2.02.28 Update
notes.notes:
ver_2.02.28 Patch Notes

[UI]
- The currently connected channel token is now displayed in the lobby.
- When launching the game for the first time, players must agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service to play.
- A tutorial guide is now displayed when launching the game for the first time.
- When attempting "Quick Join," players will now be automatically queued for up to 5 minutes and will automatically enter a room when one becomes available.
- The UI style and BGM of the title screen and lobby have been changed.
- In-game currency (Silver Bars) is now rewarded after a game ends. The amount varies depending on the number of players and the game outcome.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/fb9f059ca0781bbb5697d46309e89aeec97bf91a.gif
- In the Deduction Notebook, a red flame effect is now displayed behind the current objective’s symbol.
- When Gangcheol’s ability "Ascend" is used, the remaining duration is now displayed above the character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/66aa289f1878eaaf1a3895863d5382d9523d74ef.gif
- Players can now toggle the lobby/twilight/observer chat using the default hotkey .
- Players can now toggle the acquired clue list (Deduction Notebook) using the default hotkey .
- When assigning a color/twilight nameplate in the Deduction Notebook, the guessed spirit name is now displayed above the character.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/80235d89f33f67e3d70fc3493e469cbd5cceb1cf.gif
- If a Disguised Rat has transformed, it will still be displayed as the guessed spirit name by the observing player.
- When assigning a color/twilight nameplate in the Deduction Notebook, the player’s nickname is now displayed alongside the symbol.
- The default chat font has been adjusted to improve readability.
- The background decorations for the twilight phase have been modified (Headcrusher / Haetae / Gangcheol).
- In Coexistence & Cooperation mode, an alert has been added to notify players that the game can only start with an even number of players.

[Adjustments]

- **Spirit Abilities**
    - **Gumiho**
        - The casting range of "Allure" has been increased.
          - **Range**: 2 → **2.5**
        - The casting time of "Allure" has been reduced.
          - **Casting Time**: 2.5s → **2s**
        - Dashing can now be used while casting the ability.
    - **Dokkaebi**
        - The base cooldown of spirit abilities has been increased.
          - **Dokkaebi Invention!**
            - **Cooldown**: 20s → **30s**
    - **Preta**
        - The number of coins required for collection has been adjusted again.
          - **Required Coins**: `11 × (Player count, max 100)` → `10 × (Player count, max 100)`

- **Items**
    - The average prices of various items have been adjusted.
        - **Advanced Clue**: 25 → **20**
        - **Scroll : SPEED**: 50 → **40**
        - **Lost Time**: 12.5 → **10**
        - **Flame Heart**: 10 → **25**
        - **Hidden Card**: 27.5 → **31.5**
        - **Mystery Luggage**: 15~20 → **15~28**
        - **Confusion**: 22.5 → **15**
        - **Scroll : Random Teleport**: 7 → **5**
        - **Scroll : Alchemy**: 15 → **7**
        - **Small Trap**: 9 → **11**
        - **Hooked Gloves**: 18 → **22**
        - **Scroll : Protection**: 55 → **40**
        - **Moon & Sun Blade**: 50 → **33**
        - **Oblivion Water**: 16 → **25**
        - **Grudge**: 88 → **66**
    - Some item grades have been adjusted.
        - **Flame Heart**: **Low-tier → Mid-tier**
        - **Scroll : Alchemy**: **Mid-tier → Low-tier**
    - Some items have been **disabled**.
        - **Orb of Chaos** → **Disabled**

- **Modes**
    - The default setting for **Clairvoyance Mode** has been changed.
        - **Default Setting**: **ON → OFF**

[New Features]

- **New Skins Added** (Approximately 150 new skins)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/7a564918a23e8f0456473924a7da7d9aa3bbf355.png
    - Players must now **purchase skins** before using them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/478f801d2bde457f3c04b5c5080dc93dffe196f9.gif

- **Dash Feature Added**
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/ea48630cd3b08942c01e1271d84f0e2a11c95462.gif
- Press  + movement key to dash a short distance. (Default cooldown: 5 seconds)
- Dash distance and cooldown can be adjusted in **Astral Settings**.
- Players can use **spirit abilities, attempt eliminations, and use items** while dashing.
- Players **can be attacked** while dashing.
- Players **can attack** while dashing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/d9c7fc9b42fac6f6f4350fcfb27bf056b14af7f7.gif
- If players enter a stun state (e.g., **Ice Orb / Small Trap / Dizzy Club!**) while dashing, they will **immediately stop**.

[Bug Fixes]
- Fixed a bug where **Uchi’s Decoy!** did not transform into a talisman doll.
- Fixed a bug where **Uchi’s ability** could not be used in the **Spirit Ability Trial**.
- Fixed a bug where multiple spirits could be assigned the same color in the **Deduction Notebook**.
- Fixed an issue where **clue content** occasionally lacked investigative details.
- Fixed an issue where clues in the form of **“A’s objective is B, B”** were displayed incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue in **Coexistence & Cooperation** mode where teammate hints in the **Deduction Notebook** were being obstructed.
- Fixed a bug where players would die from the **No Takebacks** effect despite attacking in the correct order in **Tag Mode**.
- Fixed an issue where **Haetae’s ability “Gaze of Judgment”** revealed the locations of dead players.
- Fixed a bug in **In a Haze** mode where **twilight spirit symbols** could not be modified.
- Fixed an issue where **chat from the previous game** carried over to the next game.
- Fixed a bug in **Knowledge is Power** mode where the game would not end properly if only one player held an **execution right** in **Pitch Darkness**.
- Fixed a bug in **Knowledge is Power** mode where, during **Pitch Darkness**, the game would end in total elimination if neither of the last two remaining players had an **execution right**.

notes.title: Demo_ver_2.02.16 Update
notes.notes:
DEMO_ver_2.02.16

[Updates]


 Fixed a bug where moved nameplates in Twilight were not reflected in the deduction notebook.
 Fixed an issue where the game announcement background UI occasionally did not disappear.
 Fixed a bug where the font of texts appearing in Advanced Clues was incorrect.
 Fixed an issue where the death marker (X mark) for a Vengeful Spirit disappeared after being killed by one.
 Fixed errors in certain costumes (Death Lord, Gonryongpo).


[Adjustments]


 The difficulty of the "Practice Archery" task in Yama's Palace and Revelation Hell has been increased.
 The aiming reticle size has been reduced.
 The hit point range has been reduced, making it harder to achieve high scores.
 The completion requirement for the "Fix Needle Trap" task in the Chaos Entrance has been reduced by one.
 Twilight
 Now, when a player dies, all nameplates will be automatically placed in the correct position upon entering Twilight.
 When placing a nameplate and soul sigil in Twilight, "{Soul Name}?" will now be displayed below the player's nickname.
 When moving a nameplate is impossible (due to Reaper abilities or eliminated souls), "{Soul Name}" will be displayed instead.
        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/c01008e46108203d08332f894244dcfcd24f3b7b.png
        

 In-game voice chat
 The default microphone sensitivity is now set to 80%.


[New Features]

Mode-related


 Clairvoyance
 Category: Environment
 Default: ON
 The location of all living opponents is displayed on the map.
 If cloaked by the Dokkaebi Hood or shadowed by the Headcrusher's fear ability, a player's location will be temporarily hidden.
 The location of players in a Vengeful Spirit state is not visible.
 Players in a Vengeful Spirit state cannot see the location of living players.


Rules


 New Rule - "Mutual Fate"
 When creating a waiting room, you can now select rule options. (Who's Next? / Mutual Fate)
 This applies a tag-and-hunt rule with your partner. Find your partner and eliminate the target group.
 At the start of the game, you will be given the following information:
 Your soul
 Your partner's soul
 The group of souls you must eliminate

        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/afe8866e98261ef1da7102ecee8f34f99eae8f73.png

      The holder of your partner's soul is not known at the start, and you can attack your partner. There is no penalty for attacking your partner, but you will be left alone.
      The game continues until only one team remains.
      The last surviving player(s) and their team will win the game.

        
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/e61aa0cc52517733b12865944c598aca7ae8a22a.png
        

      You can attack and use tools against your partner, inflicting penalties.
      The following soul abilities also apply to your partner:
          - The Gumiho's charm can be used to eliminate your partner.
          - The Dokkaebi's Bewitching Club! can disrupt your partner.
          - The Headcrusher's partner will also be affected by their ability, reducing visibility.
          - The Shape-shifting Rat's Disguise! can be used to transform into your partner.

      The following abilities do not affect partners:
          - The possession effect of Uchi's Seventh Wish! does not affect partners.
          - The Headcrusher's Delirium ability does not change partners.
      When using Haetae's "Gaze of Judgment" in Mutual Fate, up to two hunter locations will be displayed (Hunter A and B).

     This mode currently requires an even number of players to start.
      Supports 4 to 10 players.

      Additional clues appear exclusively in Mutual Fate.
          - General clues:
              - A and A' are not partners. (Appears from Day 2)
              - A's partner is either A or A'. (Appears from Day 2)
              - A's partner soul is either B or B'. (Appears from Day 2)

      This rule is currently in the testing phase, and Chaos options cannot be selected (fixed mode settings).

          - The following settings cannot be used in Mutual Fate:
              - Vengeful Spirit
              - Blind and Foolish
              - A Golden Opportunity
              - Chaos
              - In a Haze
              - Knowledge is Power

          - The following settings are available in Mutual Fate:
              - Basic settings (time, speed, shop, appearing souls)
              - Clairvoyance - Default: ON
              - Spilled Milk - Default: ON
              - Showdown (activated in 2:1 or 1:1 situations) - Default: ON
              - High Alert - Default: OFF
              - Harsh Winter - Default: OFF
              - Unlucky Day - Default: OFF
              - Before the Storm - Default: OFF
              - Bounty - Default: OFF
              - Ferry Money - Default: OFF
              - Strike Gold - Default: OFF

notes.title: Demo_ver_2.01.18 HotFix
notes.notes:
Demo_ver_2.01.18 HorFix

In-Game Bug Fixes

- Gatekeepers and incorrectly rendered objects in the Yeomra Palace lobby have been repositioned.
- Fixed a bug where non-existent game maps could be selected during game creation.
- Fixed an issue where the clue "A is not B" displayed the soul (B) of the player who obtained the clue, leading to meaningless clues.
- Fixed an issue where “Hidden Card” could be used on a concealed Dokkaebi, causing the tool to disappear without effect.
- Fixed a bug where switching perspectives in deceased possession mode caused the deceased voice channel to be heard again.
- Fixed a bug where the sound of shooting arrows persisted if the “Archery Practice” task was interrupted.

Game Settings (Heavenly Sphere)

    - Night: Default 90 seconds → 60 seconds

- The activation cycle of [Harsh Winter] has been increased.
    - Activation cycle: 20–60 seconds → 60–120 seconds
- Conditions for [Before Storm] have been adjusted.
    - Night of the 4th day becomes pitch-black → Night of the 3rd day becomes pitch-black.

Clues

- [Clues] are the most impactful element of the game system. To improve game longevity, the amount of unlocked information has been reduced in previous updates. However, for games with 8 or more players, this made gameplay overly difficult. Clues have been reworked to reveal more information, encouraging discussions and sharing among players. (23 clues → 15 clues)

- Clues collected during the day can now be strategically shared during twilight, allowing players to subtly mix truth with lies for both gathering information and misleading others.

- Clues involving "relationships of the deceased" will now appear in past tense.
    - Ex) In the relationship between Gumiho → Dokkaebi → Dark Eater, if Dokkaebi has died, the clue "Gumiho is closest to Dokkaebi" will now appear as "Gumiho was closest to Dokkaebi."

- Low-value location-related clues have been removed.
    - Removed clues:
        - A’s first task was C.
        - A’s most recent task was C.
        - B’s most recent location was D.
        - A killed A’ with XX.
        - B accidentally attacked A and died.
        - A accidentally attacked A’ and died.
        - B accidentally attacked B’ and died.
        - A is unrelated to B.
        - B is unrelated to A.
        - A is unrelated to A’.

- Clues that were difficult to understand have been revised.
    - A’s starting position was D → Now only appears during the first day.
    - A is one of B, B’, B’’ → A is one of B, B’.
    - B is one of A, A’, A’’ → B is one of A, A’.
    - A is related to B → A is closest to B.
    - B is related to A → B is closest to A.

- Stronger clues have been added.
    - A’s target is one of B, B’.
    - B’s target is one of A, A’.
    - A is currently the wealthiest (NN coins).
    - B currently possesses E (excluding soul-specific tools like Dokkaebi or Preta tools).
    - B has never purchased a tool.
    - A is a soul with an active ability (one of Gumiho, Dokkaebi, Dark Eater, Headcrusher, Haetae, Woochi, Gangchul).
    - A is a soul with a twilight ability (one of Reaper, Dungaprat, Preta).
    - A has used their soul ability N times.

Soul Abilities

- Dokkaebi
    - Ambidextrous
    - When Dokkaebi creates a Dokkaebi tool while holding an active tool, the held tool will now be automatically consumed.
        - Process: Use soul ability → Consume held tool → Grant Dokkaebi tool
        - Ex) Using the Dokkaebi ability while holding "Lost Time" will result in a -30-second cooldown reduction for the next ability.

- Woochi
    - Prayer Meter
        - Woochi’s 7th Wish "Possession Ability" can now reactivate after the first possession by making another 7th wish.
    - Woochi’s ability activation probabilities have been adjusted:
        - All 33% →
            - Blink Everywhere! → 40%
            - Clone Technique! → 33%
            - 7th Wish → 27%

- Gangchul
    - The Imoogi that Became a Dragon
    - Gangchul’s abilities have been reworked.
    - [Removed]
        - [The Imoogi Longing to Be a Dragon] - Additional abilities granted based on the amount of coins collected.
    - [New]
        - Ability Name: (Active) Ascend
        - Cost: 50 coins
        - After 1 second of focus, enter the [Ascend] state for 10 seconds. A stationary [Dragon Orb] will appear at the current location. At the end of the duration, Gangchul will teleport to the orb’s location, and [Ascend] will end.
        - [Ascend]
            - Movement speed +30%
            - Increases in size and takes on a dragon form.
            - Cannot be targeted by attacks, soul abilities, or tools (temporary invincibility).
            - Can fly, ignoring terrain obstacles.
            - Cannot perform tasks.

[New Features]

- [Yeomra Palace] is the sacred district where Yeomra, the ruler of the afterlife, deliberates on events in the underworld with his officials and enshrines the seven most righteous and great souls. Hello! This is HellAssociation, the developer of Who's Next?
This patch note covers the fixes and adjustments made in the b version of the 1.12.21 patch. The next regular version patch is scheduled for January 4th (ver_2.01.04).
Thank you for playing our game!

In-Game Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the UI icon of the top clock was not visible during twilight hours.
- Fixed a bug where the character would disappear if killed during teleportation after focusing while using Scroll: Random Teleport or Uchi’s ability.
- Fixed an issue where the goal for deceased players was fixed as “Headcrusher” after using Headcrusher's ability. Deceased players now appear to have no assigned goals when Headcrusher uses their ability.
- Fixed a bug where Preta’s required coin count was not properly applied. Preta now correctly needs to collect (number of players x 11) coins.
- Fixed an issue where players in the Changgui state were not receiving the +10% movement speed buff.
- Fixed a bug where the leaderboard was not displayed properly when Changgui wiped out all players. Now, in cases of total annihilation by Changgui, no ranking is shown, and the order of elimination is displayed instead.

- Fixed an issue where abilities could be used while in the [Stun] status.

- Fixed a bug where Preta could acquire the “Straw Shoes” item, which was not supposed to be obtainable via fake tools.

Leaderboard

The leaderboard now displays special highlights. (Currently 6 types):
Most Dishonorable Victory: Given to a soul who wins with 1 or fewer kills in a game with 6 or more players.
- This is an honorary title! In the afterlife, cunning and dishonorable souls are admired!
Most Fearsome Soul: Given to a soul who eliminated more than half the players.
Vengeful Soul: Awarded to a Changgui with 2 or more kills and the highest kill count.
Rich Soul with No Fare: Awarded to a soul who left behind over 50 coins but failed to win.
Strategist Soul: Given to the soul who bought and used 5 or more tools from the shop.
Diligent Worker Soul: Awarded to the soul who completed 10 or more tasks.

notes.notes:
October 26 Demo Update Notice

Hello,

This is HellAssociation, the developers of Who's Next?.

Below is a list of bug fixes and balance patches based on bugs found over about ten days since the demo release. There are quite a few bug fixes, so if you're only interested in gameplay updates, you can skip ahead to the [Adjustments] section below.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve the game.

---
[Bug and Feature Fixes List]

In-Game Fixes

- Fixed incorrect clue code display when obtaining general clues; 'STR_TASK_FIREHELLSMELTING_NAME' now appears correctly.
- New “blank” clues have been added. Watch out for unrelated clues like "Next time..." / "Short ribs recipe..." / "Miss you, Miss…" which have no connection to the target relationships.
- The label for "Advanced Clues" has changed from "Goal of XX at Start" to "Current Goal of XX."
- Fixed a bug where items purchased from the shop and used immediately remained after the shop time expired.
- Fixed a bug where Dokkaebi tools were visible to everyone during twilight.
- Fixed a bug where items purchased by other players were not visible during twilight.
- When it becomes pitch dark, the direction of the last remaining opponent is now visible.
- Fixed a bug where dead players were visible to living players.
- Fixed a bug where the appearance of a deceased player (Dummy Amulet!) persisted even after the game ended.
- Fixed an issue where spirits of already deceased players did not follow the 'X' marker when Headcrusher's ‘Mental Confusion’ ability was used.
- Fixed an issue where the current objective guide text did not change when Headcrusher's ‘Mental Confusion’ ability was used.
- Now, when the Dokkaebi cloak tool is used for stealth, debuff markers are no longer visible to other players. (Perfect Dark Templar)
- Fixed a bug where, if you purchased a second *Scroll : SPEED* while already holding it, the speed buff would disappear.

Other UI and UX Fixes
Tutorial dialogue was updated to show the movement keys as "W A S D" instead of "W S A D."
Corrected typos and inaccurate terms in tutorial dialogues.
The tutorial’s spirit guide tab now includes a preview of tools used by specific spirits (such as Dokkaebi and Preta).
Updated the “Spirit Trial Mode” in the tutorial so that objectives can change based on items/abilities.
Improved UI interaction when settings or help are open, making it clearer which UI elements are disabled.
Enhanced the game-end sound effect to celebrate victory. (Let the music play~!)
The victory screen now shows the spirits alongside the nicknames of deceased players.
In Observer Mode (deceased state), the items held by surviving players are now displayed beside their names.
The room host can now force players to leave from the Waiting Room’s options panel (General tab, Waiting Room players section).
Sound effects now play when using abilities of Reaper, Shapeshifter Rat, and Dark Shikini.

Tasks
Improved responsiveness when polishing grave headstones. (Now you don’t have to scrub so hard.)
Enhanced responsiveness when interacting with the scarecrow. (It’s…spooky…)
Fixed a bug where completing the talisman drawing task was possible without tracing the lines.
Fixed a distortion issue with the name display when incense was burned on a spirit headstone.
Incense burning now visibly produces smoke when completed on a spirit headstone.
Fixed a bug where the incense task would award multiple rewards upon completion.
Players can no longer complete tasks after death unless the “Chang-Gwi” option is enabled.
Spirits unable to perform tasks during the night will no longer see task location markers on the map (X marker).
Fixed an issue with intermittent clicks failing on the “Forge the Trident” task.
Increased the reward currency for tasks with longer completion times.

Voice Chat Fixes
Improved the quality of voice chat audio.
Fixed a bug where players could hear each other’s voices for a few seconds at the start of a game.
Fixed an issue where selected microphone devices in options were not applying correctly.
Fixed an issue where the microphone could not be turned back on after leaving and re-entering the waiting room while muted.

Character Skin Fixes
Fixed a bug where repeated interactions with the wardrobe key would prevent character movement.
Fixed an issue where head costume resets failed when entering a different room after equipping it in the previous waiting room.
The wardrobe UI has been completely revamped.
New exclusive skins that were previously unavailable have been added. They are free to use in the demo version!
The 2024 Halloween Event has arrived! Check out the special Halloween skins in the new wardrobe (see image below).

[Adjustments]

Spirit Balance Adjustments

- Headcrusher: Oh, My Head!

Headcrusher’s ability, ‘Mental Confusion,’ is designed as an obstacle to prolong the game and challenge other players’ deductions. However, during the last demo, it caused more headaches than anticipated. 
 - The cooldown for Headcrusher’s ability ‘Mental Confusion’ has been adjusted:
60 seconds → 300 seconds

- Dokkaebi: Extra! Extra!
The Dokkaebi’s mystical tool, ‘Great News,’ forces all spirits to reveal themselves. To maintain its power while not overly exposing other players’ information, the spawn rate has been adjusted. 
 - Spawn rate adjustments for Dokkaebi’s “Dokkaebi Club” tool:
Endless Bag (20% → 20%)
Dokkaebi Statue (20% → 25%)
Dizzying Club (20% → 25%)
Dokkaebi Cloak (20% → 25%)
Great News (20% → 5%)

- Reaper: Is this correct?
The Reaper’s ‘Life and Death Scroll’ can position the chosen player accurately at dusk, ensuring clarity for the user’s position. 
 - Targets affected by Reaper’s ability now have fixed nameplates that cannot be moved.

- Preta: Promised Level 100
Preta is a high-risk, high-reward spirit. While initially limited to bluffing, it is designed to benefit from collecting 100 coins. However, in the last demo, Preta often became a public target upon reaching this threshold. 
 - Adjusted effects upon activation of Preta’s ability:
Preta’s identity is now hidden upon activation (name and “Endless Hunger” indicator are not visible to other players).
Preta now appears more “feral” in the Frenzy state (camera effects added).

Tool Balance Adjustments
- Speed Is Power - Ever Been Cut at the Speed of Light? 
 - Grade and price adjustments for Scroll : SPEED: 
- Grade: Low → Special 
- Average Price: 8 coins → 37 coins

- Lucky RNG Game 
 - Probability adjustments for tools obtained from Mystery Luggage: 
- Low-grade: 30% 
- Mid-grade: 40% 
- High-grade: 25% 
- Special-grade: 5%
